title: Payment API returning HTTP 500
description: The Payment API is experiencing an increase in HTTP 500 responses, affecting the /checkout flow. Onset began minutes after deployment v2.8.1.
impact: ~12% of payment requests failing and checkout latency up to 4x. Checkout flow partially degraded.
summary: HTTP 500 spike on Payment API detected 4 minutes after deployment v2.8.1. Authorize-payment step is the primary failing operation.

timeline.title: Deployment v2.8.1
timeline.detail: payment-api v2.8.1 released by J. Chen (commit a1b2c3d).

timeline.title: Latency begins increasing
timeline.detail: payment-api p50 latency rising from ~90ms toward 190ms.

timeline.title: HTTP 500 spike detected
timeline.detail: Error rate jumps +38%; /checkout is the most affected endpoint.

timeline.title: Incident created
timeline.detail: Rootline detected the anomaly and opened INC-2391 (P1).

timeline.title: Investigation started
timeline.detail: Correlation engine linked deployment v2.8.1 + error rate + /checkout.

timeline.title: AI hypothesis generated
timeline.detail: Strongest correlation: recent deployment to payment-api (82% confidence).

timeline.title: Engineer reviewing evidence
timeline.detail: L. Chen inspecting deployment diff and affected endpoint traces.

affectedServices.impact: Elevated latency due to payment dependency

title: Auth API increased latency
description: Session validation calls on Auth API are ~2.5x slower than baseline, increasing login and token refresh times.
impact: Login and token refresh slower for a subset of users.
summary: Latency degradation on auth-api, currently being monitored after mitigation.

timeline.title: Investigation started
timeline.detail: Correlated with Redis cache miss rate increase.

timeline.title: Cache warming
timeline.detail: M. Silva warmed session cache; latency stabilized.

title: Catalog search degradation
description: Product search under degraded performance returning partial results during index refresh.
impact: Search slow for a fraction of catalog traffic.
summary: Partial search results while the index is refreshed. Mitigation in progress.

timeline.title: Index rebuild
timeline.detail: A. Kumar triggered full index rebuild.

title: Search index lag
description: Search indexer fell behind on event consumption, causing stale products in search for ~40 minutes.
impact: Low impact — search results stale for a short window.
summary: Consumer lag on search indexer resolved by rebalancing partitions.

timeline.title: Incident resolved
timeline.detail: Lag back to zero; search healthy.

resolution.rootCause: Consumer group imbalance on the search indexer
resolution.mitigation: Added alert for consumer lag threshold.
